name: subagent-router
description: Picks the model and effort for each sub-agent from the task, and nudges the main session to delegate token-heavy work.

respectExplicitModel.title: Respect a model the caller chose
respectExplicitModel.description: When on, a sub-agent call that already names a model keeps it; only effort is filled in.

topModel.title: Model for complex tasks
topModel.description: Model used for planning, architecture, deep debugging and reviews.

delegationGuidance.title: Add delegation guidance to the system prompt
delegationGuidance.description: Tells the main session to hand searches and independent sub-tasks to sub-agents with tight briefs.
